plan.design_status: Retrospective posterior sampling of a registry case on published duplicate means. Never blind or independent validation.
plan.source: FungMod posterior sampling of the T. harzianum P49P11 cellulose registry case (hydrolysis candidate) on the Gelain 2020 cellulose cultures at 10, 20 and 30 g/L (article doi:10.1016/j.cesx.2020.100085, data doi:10.17632/shd3wcczsr.2; observations data/benchmarks/gelain_2020_v2/observations.json). Priors are the v2 joint-benchmark bounds, log-uniform. The error model is an assumption (independent Gaussian errors with standard deviation 10 percent of each observable's training maximum, biomass/substrate correlation -0.5) scaled by one multiplier shared by the four observables and sampled jointly with the parameters; the multiplier sets the overall error level from the residuals, keeps the declared relative weighting, and absorbs model misfit and measurement noise together because the deposit holds no replicates or standard deviations.

priors.source: Log-uniform within the explicit broad exploratory bounds declared before v2 fitting (data/benchmarks/gelain_2020_v2/plan.json); no published value narrows a prior.

error_model.source: Declared assumption only, carried over from the v2 correlated_assumption scenario: SD = 10 percent of each observable's training maximum across the three cellulose loadings, biomass/substrate correlation -0.5 from the sign suggested by mass-difference assays, temporal errors independent. Neither magnitude is measured; the deposit holds no replicates or standard deviations.

noise_scale_priors.label: all_observables
noise_scale_priors.source: One log-uniform multiplier on the assumed base standard deviations of all four observables, sampled jointly with the parameters because the measurement error is unknown. Shared so that the declared relative weighting of the observables is kept; it absorbs model misfit together with measurement noise. A per-observable variant is recorded as a sensitivity study in plan_per_observable_scales.json.

sampler.initial_center: frozen least-squares fit data/benchmarks/gelain_2020_v2/results/full_fits/cellulose_hydrolysis_primary.json with a unit noise-scale multiplier

notes: Posterior sampling on published duplicate means; no replicate-level data exist in the deposit, so the shared noise-scale multiplier conflates measurement error and model misfit.
The registry records keep their frozen least-squares point values; this study reports which of them the data identify and which must be kept as ranges.
Retrospective development analysis of one strain and preparation; not validation, not a prediction for other conditions.
plan.completion_rule: Code and numerical verification can pass. Identifiability verdicts are conditional on the declared prior box and error assumptions; model validation still requires matched independent data with measured errors.

predictor.integration: compiled stoichiometric right-hand side on scipy.solve_ivp with the config's solver settings
